instructions.instruction: Gather requirements first: resource type, target Kubernetes version, replicas, ports, volumes, namespace, labels and CRD specifics.
For a CRD, consult its documentation for the right project, kind and API version before generating; fall back to a version-specific web search, and always include the version.
Apply the app.kubernetes.io recommended labels consistently across every resource.
Use explicit, non-deprecated API versions that match the target Kubernetes version (for example Ingress is networking.k8s.io/v1 from 1.19).
NEVER omit resource requests and limits from container specs.
NEVER create Deployments without liveness and readiness probes.
Set a non-root securityContext (runAsNonRoot) and follow Pod Security Standards.
NEVER put secrets in ConfigMaps or as plain env values; use Secret objects referenced with secretKeyRef.
NEVER use the latest image tag; pin an immutable version and set imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent.
Specify the namespace explicitly on every namespace-scoped resource; never rely on the default namespace.
NEVER mismatch selector labels between a Service and the Deployment it targets.
Always validate generated YAML with the k8s-yaml-validator workflow before delivery, and fix and re-validate until it is clean.
For multi-resource output, respect dependency order (ConfigMaps before Deployments), keep labels consistent, validate each resource, and combine with --- separators.
Deliver the validated YAML with a brief summary, the key configuration choices and next steps (kubectl apply, get, describe).
NEVER inline secret values in CI pipeline commands using heredocs; reference Secrets, Sealed Secrets or external-secrets instead.
Route validation of an existing manifest to k8s-yaml-validator, do not generate Helm template logic, and copy and adapt a near-identical existing resource instead of generating a fresh one.
